description: ChatGPT only: adds photos the person attached in the chat to one of their draft listings (up to 8 in all), which ChatGPT passes as files with download links. Never use photos from the web or anywhere else: a listing shows the seller's own item. Other assistants can't pass attached photos to a tool: give the person the listing's upload page link instead (create_listing and get_listing return it). Location and camera details are removed from every photo. Needs sign-in.
name: add_listing_photos
title: Add photos to a listing
